Gordon Glenister (Author, Journalist, Keynote Speaker 350+ events, Podcaster & Creator Economy Expert, Influencer Strategists, Membership World Community, I help clients WIN with Influence and Authority)
Really looking forward to what I think this year will be the biggest Cannes ever for those in the creator economy.  If you have never been it will BLOW YOUR MIND!! Everyone is overwhelmed with what the team at Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity put on. 

✅ Award ceremonies for 5 nights, packed full of over 3k people. They get over 25k award entries - winning an award at Cannes is the highest honour
✅ More countries than anything else on the planet
✅ Celebrities, including Will I Am, Halle Berry, and Paris Hilton are all regulars
✅ The biggest global brands on the planet are meeting or speaking
✅ The biggest press room you'll ever see
✅ Hotel rates on the Croisette that will make your eyes water
✅ Over 1,000 events taking place OUTSIDE of the festival

Influencer Strategists are arranging a dinner on the 22nd let me know if you would like to join us. We also have a dedicated Whatsapp group for those coming to Cannes - feel free to send me a message

Steve Benbow (We build web apps in 2 weeks for £5000 — 5000.dev — Twickenham, United Kingdom)
Cannes is one of those weeks where everyone stacks meetings and forgets why they came. I’ve seen more business come from 3 honest conversations than 30 rushed coffees at big events. What’s your filter for deciding which side events are actually worth the time?
